MARKETING_ANALYTICS_REPORT.TITLE: Campaign Analytics
MARKETING_ANALYTICS_REPORT.SUBTITLE: Cost, CPL and ROAS by Meta ad and Google campaign.
MARKETING_ANALYTICS_REPORT.COMING_SOON: Cost, CPL and ROAS breakdown per campaign and ad is on the way.
MARKETING_ANALYTICS_REPORT.EMPTY: No campaign data in the selected range.

MARKETING_ANALYTICS.TITLE: Marketing Analytics
MARKETING_ANALYTICS.DESCRIPTION: Send conversion events to Meta and Google when leads reach a funnel stage, get labeled, or trigger an automation.

GENERAL.TITLE: General
GENERAL.DESCRIPTION: Values used to compute Revenue and ROAS in the Analytics report.

MARKETING_ANALYTICS.DISCONNECT_CONFIRM: Disconnect this integration? Existing dispatches stay in history.

META_CAPI.DESCRIPTION: Meta Conversions API. Used for WhatsApp / Instagram DM / Facebook Messenger ads. Fires with the ctwa_clid captured on the first inbound.

GOOGLE_ADS_ENHANCED.DESCRIPTION: Google Ads uploadClickConversions. Uses the gclid captured by the landing page snippet in the first message.

FIELD_HINTS.ADS_READ_TOKEN: Optional. A token with the ads_read permission on the ad account, used only to read spend. Leave blank to use the Access Token above, which stays dedicated to sending conversions.

EVENTS.TITLE: Conversion events
EVENTS.DESCRIPTION: Map a Chatwoot trigger to a Meta event name and/or a Google conversion action.
EVENTS.NAME: Name
EVENTS.LABEL: Label
EVENTS.DELETE_CONFIRM: Delete the event "{name}"? Existing dispatches stay in history.

AD_ACCOUNTS.TITLE: Ad accounts
AD_ACCOUNTS.DESCRIPTION: Spend from these accounts fills Spend, CPL, CPA and ROAS on the reports. Synced every day; the token needs the ads_read permission on each account.
AD_ACCOUNTS.ID_HINT: In Meta Business Settings → Accounts → Ad accounts, or Ads Manager, next to the account name.
AD_ACCOUNTS.ADD_FAILED: Could not add this ad account.
AD_ACCOUNTS.SYNC_STARTED: Sync started — the status refreshes in a few seconds.
AD_ACCOUNTS.EMPTY: No ad account yet. Add the accounts whose spend should show on the reports.
